name: orbit-loop
prompt: A cinematic camera demonstration. The ceramic vase, olive branch and rectangular stone plinth remain completely stationary. The camera trucks in a smooth clockwise arc around the vase from a frontal view to a clear 45-degree side view, maintaining constant distance and height. Strong visible parallax: the near corner of the rectangular plinth moves across the frame and the curved background shifts behind the vase. No zoom. No rotating object. No morphing. One continuous slow orbit camera shot. Preserve the realistic studio lighting and original materials.
method: First 4 seconds followed by reverse; 8 seconds, 480x360, 24 fps, silent H.264
